$comment: Six invented screening alerts for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank. The customers, the watchlist and the alerts do not exist. SCR-2001 and SCR-2002 are false positives, SCR-2003 is a true match, SCR-2004 and SCR-2005 are uncertain, SCR-2006 is a relative of a politically exposed person. Each case names only what the bank's screening system holds.

cases.title: Wynne Castellane (SCR-2001)
cases.text:
Alert SCR-2001, a customer onboarding review, is open. It compares customer Wynne Castellane (CUS-1005) with list entry WL-9001, Wynn Castellano, a sanctions entry (invented example: trade in restricted goods). Match score 78. The matcher flagged: name (similar).
An earlier alert on the same pair, SCR-1990, is closed as a false positive. Everything here is as the screening system holds it. The agent reads the alert and the list entry from the screening system.

cases.title: Perdita Vanhollow (SCR-2006)
cases.text:
Alert SCR-2006, a periodic rescreen, is open. It compares customer Perdita Vanhollow (CUS-1010), rated high risk as related to a politically exposed person, with list entry WL-9006, Leopold Vanhollow, a politically exposed person entry (Minister of Public Works, Quenmark). It is not a sanctions entry. Match score 84. The matcher flagged: surname and related person (spouse).
An earlier alert on the same pair, SCR-1991, is closed as a true match. Everything here is as the screening system holds it. The agent reads the alert and the list entry from the screening system.
